The completed forward transfer and independent canonical norm in parent [#1521](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/pull/1521) do not yet supply a public-target destination IC interface with explicit representation bridges. This prospective continuation reuses the existing complete N4/B2 solver. Its legacy scalar parameter only constructs Q inside the counted body;subsequent solving does not use that parameter. Moving construction outside both IC/rho intervals is an accounting change,not an algorithmic gain. [pcc:unverified]

Protocol7e016c is committed in [f888bd5f](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/commit/f888bd5fe50262d0d74d85ff4caaf4e4af96c81d),parent1e4f1292/treeb3f444fe,53paths/governance24bb30,and was actually published by normal nonforce Git BEFORE any new case or native implementation. This ready PR targets the immediate parent branch;main auto-merge applies only after the parent lands. [pcc:unverified]

- P1:literal public-Q derivative of both original solver bodies,strict witness-free public inputs,original arithmetic verification,and five fixed q223seed1 correctness targets with the original six-attempt B2 retry cap. All five IC solves must succeed before that smoke is accepted;every retry/wrong answer/exhaustion remains evidence. No generic-DLP fallback in IC.
- P2:additive V2 constructor and explicit field,elliptic/plane model,basepoint,completed-fibre and canonical-norm bridges. Keep V1 frozen admission,private normal forms/origin and all old source/control/proof subjects unchanged. Written proofs and feasible faithful Lean bindings are required;actual-geometry gaps stay explicit.
- Twelve whole primary sources match the catalog in parentb992d8/actual5327f4. ONE inspected35,418-byte proposal PDFpagead4849 has editable DOT/SVG/Typst/JSON. Dashed diagram edges are proposals. No new curve identity exists yet;candidate_id is null. Parent437 inputs and whole seven-job workflow are unchanged. Extra prospective-protocol prose lint1 is preserved6f4d8a;future proof/solve instructions are not achieved claims. Required claim surfaces and original gates pass. [pcc:unverified]

No new case,solver,proof or benchmark has run in this PR yet. Legacy N4/B2 cost tables are not newly adopted;withdrawn subgroup-enumeration IC smokes remain negative evidence. Comparative work still needs actual S3checkpoint/live budget/capacity admission,strongest applicable references and all material cold phases. Root fixture access and main conflict/frozenledger/signing/reviews remain separate. Queue:[crypto#3904](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/issues/3904). Next:implement and test P1,then advance to P2. [pcc:unverified]
